result: 7 passed in 6.10s from fresh installed wheels; core, FastAPI, Prefect, SQL, and SQLModel imports resolved from the isolated environment site-packages.
assertions: After the third automatic pre-claim generation fails, the durable dispatch enters reconciliation_required, retains the exact failed flow-run ID, and no longer appears as pending or claimable work.
Authorized status still reads the linked Prefect run and reports its failed state, dispatch status, generation, and bounded diagnostic alongside canonical reconciliation_required status.
An operator retry requires execution.dispatch.reconcile, the exact generation and flow-run ID, and a bounded evidence note; compare-and-swap rejects stale requests.

The durable store rechecks an active route, no active execution lease, and no canonical attempt, effect, or publication before generating a new creation key; it persists the acting principal and evidence digest without storing the note, and emits an idempotent audit event.

Cancelling an unresolved exhausted acceptance or a still-pending dispatch finalizes delivery as cancelled and clears route drain counters; uncertain and leased dispatches remain outstanding and prevent retirement.
SQLModel snapshot reconstruction preserves reconciliation history and its actor/evidence digest without a new provider table or migration.

The installed-wheel HTTP operator route rejects a cross-tenant caller before mutation, rearms only the exact exhausted generation for an authorized principal, redacts the evidence note, rejects a stale retry with 409, and emits one reconciliation audit event.

runtime.wheel_environment: Fresh CPython 3.11.15 virtual environment; all ETLantic packages loaded from site-packages; inherited PYTHONPATH unset; pytest pythonpath disabled and importlib mode enabled.

limitations: This installed-wheel contract campaign uses SQLite durable stores and a controlled Prefect client; it does not qualify the operator route against live PostgreSQL, a self-hosted Prefect server, or multiple API processes.
The authorization case uses MemoryAuthorizer and proves tenant/workspace isolation behavior only; production identity-provider policy and credential lifecycle remain unqualified.
The authorized retry is limited to a failed or aged missing remote run established as pre-claim; ambiguous create-response recovery continues to reuse its existing creation key.
source_sha256_method: SHA-256 over sorted repository-relative source paths and file bytes, with NUL separators.
